weekLabel: Week of Jul 12 - 19 · refreshed Sun Jul 12. Tap a source to confirm before you go.

events.name: World Cup Final Watch Party — Somerville
events.meta: Free, tickets required · Union Square Plaza + Capuano Field at Glen Park · Huge outdoor LED screen, food vendors, DJs, kid activities. The Final from MetLife at 3pm, with a Shakira/Madonna/BTS halftime. Free but capacity-controlled, so RESERVE NOW. source

events.name: Yarmouth Clam Festival
events.meta: Free entry · Yarmouth ME · Fried clams, 3 music stages, 130+ craft booths, carnival rides. Parade Fri 6pm (streets close 5:30), fireworks Sat night. Big crowds, tight parking: go early and park at the edge of the village. source

events.name: ArtBeat 2026: REVolution — Davis Square
events.meta: Free · Somerville · 40th year. Davis Square closes to traffic: 70+ craft vendors, food, two stages of music, dance and theater. Closest big festival to home. Rain date Sun Jul 19. source

events.name: Salisbury Beach Concert + Fireworks
events.meta: Free · Oceanfront stage concert, then fireworks over the water. Beach + free music + fireworks for all five. Arrive before 7 for parking. source

events.name: Sail Boston — last three days of the tall ships
events.meta: Free · Free ship boarding through Wed at the Seaport, Fish Pier and Charlestown Navy Yard (Fish Pier opens noon Sun, 2pm Mon-Wed). Festival at 302 Northern Ave: live entertainment, concessions, Ferris wheel. Ships depart Thu morning. Take the T. source

events.name: Sail Boston finale — Marine Band + harbor fireworks
events.meta: Free · 2nd Marine Division Band at the DCR Hatch Shell 6:30-8:30, then fireworks off Fan Pier at 9:15 over the tall ships. The closing night, and the last look at the fleet. source

events.name: Sail Boston Cup — crew soccer tournament
events.meta: Free · LoPresti Park, East Boston · 5v5 tournament between tall-ship crews and cadets from multiple countries, in honor of the World Cup. Free, outdoors, on the water. Easy weekday morning for Alex. source

events.name: Cinderella at Prescott Park
events.meta: Free, $8 suggested donation · Portsmouth NH · The outdoor waterfront musical, blanket seating under the stars. Made for KK and Isabella; Portsmouth dinner is steps away. Among the last July dates. source

events.name: Blackburn Brew Fest (21+)
events.meta: Ticketed · 21+ ONLY, ID required · Stage Fort Park, Gloucester · 20+ breweries, live music, food trucks, lawn games, right on the ocean. Rain or shine, capped at 2,000 tickets. A Dave-and-Stacey night, not a family one. source

events.name: Revolution vs Toronto FC
events.meta: Ticketed, from ~$30/match · MLS restarts right after the Final; Revs host Atlanta Jul 25 too. The affordable live-soccer follow-up for Dave & Alex. source

events.name: Boston Landmarks Orchestra — Hatch Shell opener
events.meta: Free · Esplanade · 25th-anniversary season of free orchestra nights on the river opens. Wednesdays through Aug 12. Bring blankets. source

events.name: Lynch Park Summer Concert — North Shore Roots Band
events.meta: Free · Beverly · Free concert in the shell at the family's favorite oceanfront park. Chairs and blankets. Confirm act and time on the Rec Dept page (verify). source

events.name: Yankee Homecoming — Newburyport
events.meta: Mostly free · Nine days of waterfront concerts, craft fair, road race and fireworks in a favorite walkable town. Schedule still firming up (verify). source

events.name: Maine Lobster Festival — Rockland
events.meta: Ticketed grounds · 79th year: lobster every way, the parade, live music on the bay. Full-day-plus trip. source
